# What do you actually take home from Gumroad?

> Free Gumroad fee calculator for sellers: drop in your sales CSV and see the service fee actually taken, take-home per order, net revenue per product, repeat buyers, refunds, withdrawal costs, funds still clearing and the price needed for a target take-home. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
